run_msn_training: run the main MSN unsupervised pre-training loop with a config dict containing model, data, and optimization parameters
load_checkpoint: load a saved training checkpoint including encoder, target encoder, prototypes, and optimizer state from a path
init_model: initialize a DEiT encoder model with a configurable projection head and optional batch normalization layers
init_opt: initialize an AdamW optimizer with warmup cosine learning rate and weight decay schedulers for the encoder
review_main_training_loop: review the main training loop that performs MSN loss computation, gradient clipping, momentum updates, and checkpointing
